observations.explanation: The paper describes storing a reflection in memory, resetting the environment, and beginning another trial (PDF pp. 3–4). It evaluates ReAct-based Refl exion on AlfWorld and HotPotQA (PDF pp. 5–6), matching the claim’s stated scope.

The results report that Refl exion solved 97% of 134 AlfWorld environments over 12 trials, with four tasks unsolved; the assessment appropriately limits the inference to the selected benchmark tasks (PDF p. 5).
The abstract reports 51% for HotPotQA, while the results section reports 54% (PDF pp. 1, 6). This is a discrepancy in the paper’s reported figures.

The paper reports evaluations on 134 AlfWorld environments and 100 HotPotQA questions, but the supplied text does not describe independent-run variability or robustness across samples or model settings (PDF pp. 5–6). The observation is carefully framed as limited information and uncertainty, not as a demonstrated flaw.
